title: North Carolina partners with Tanium to strengthen state cybersecurity
summary: The partnership is part of a broader effort to shift North Carolina's cybersecurity from reactive to proactive.

title: California launches pilot for ‘Career Passport’ digital  workforce tool
summary: The pilot program aims to give workers a portable, verified record of their competencies while helping employers identify qualified candidates based on demonstrated skills rather than traditional degree requirements.

title: Massachusetts awards $1M across 20 local governments, schools in new cyber grants
summary: The grants for 20 local governments and schools are part of Massachusetts' new $1 million Cybersecurity Remediation Grant Program.

title: How San José trained 1,000 city employees to build their own AI tools
summary: San José’s chief innovation officer said that the government adopted a “bottom-up” approach that encourages employees to identify challenges and develop solutions themselves.

title: Coalition of state lawmakers again urges Congress to reject AI preemption proposal
summary: The state lawmakers again voiced their oppostion to a proposed three-year preemption on state AI laws, urging federal lawmakers to reject it.

title: Missouri expands drone restrictions around critical infrastructure as World Cup starts
summary: House Bill 2637 expands the state's existing "critical infrastructure facility" drone law and broadens its authority to regulate unmanned aircraft systems.

title: New York’s IT office partners with AWS for cloud and AI services, strategy saving taxpayers $58M
summary: New York state's contract with AWS is a key part of the state's goal of consolidating its IT contracts, which has so far saved $58 million.

title: New California CIO Chris Given wants technology to be an enabler, not a bottleneck
summary: Given said his early focus will be helping agencies tackle legacy technology systems, expand digital identity services and build on California's leadership in artificial intelligence.

title: Anthropic launches $15M cyber defense program for state, local, tribal and territorial governments
summary: California and Texas have already joined Anthropic's new SLTT cyber defense program.

title: Dallas deploys new digital kiosks as FIFA World Cup kicks off
summary: The city launched a network of interactive digital kiosks, in partnership with IKE Smart City, which offer users fan engagement opportunities and operational updates as North Texas begins hosting tournament activities this weekend.
